items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: The man who taught me and my dad, Mr. Longmyer, I admire him tremendously.

ctx.x: Musically, how did he affect your career? What did he do for you?

Well, he made me -- well I learned a lot from him, playing with him, in front of him, well, for instance feeling, approach, so much, you know. And that way, and I thought about somebody else. I'm still trying to think of him.

Well I mentioned Caroline Thornton. I mean I wish lots of times I could have been the musician she was. It was like being with Fats, because she was capable. She knew what she was doing. She did it, and did it damn well. The man who taught me and my dad, Mr. Longmyer, I admire him tremendously. Oh, he was such a man, and a musician.
